question: How many students from the ages of 5 to 17 are enrolled at the State Special School school in Fremont for the 2014-2015 academic year?

attempts.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)"),0)
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE frpm."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
  AND schools.EdOpsCode = 'SSS'
  AND (schools.City = 'Fremont' OR schools.County = 'Fremont' OR schools.District = 'Fremont');
attempts.raw:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)"),0)
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE frpm."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
  AND schools.EdOpsCode = 'SSS'
  AND (schools.City = 'Fremont' OR schools.County = 'Fremont' OR schools.District = 'Fremont');

question: How many customers who choose statement of weekly issuance are Owner?

attempts.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT disp.client_id) AS num_owners_weekly
FROM disp
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

FROM disp
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'

question: Which molecules have triple bonds and list all the elements they contain.

attempts.sql:
SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, group_concat(DISTINCT a.element) AS elements
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = '#'
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label;
attempts.raw:
SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, group_concat(DISTINCT a.element) AS elements
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = '#'
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label;

question: Among all the lap records set on various circuits, what is the time for the fastest one?

attempts.sql:
SELECT time
FROM lapTimes
WHERE milliseconds = (
  SELECT MIN(min_ms) FROM (
    SELECT MIN(lt.milliseconds) AS min_ms
    FROM lapTimes lt
    JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
    GROUP BY r.circuitId
  ) AS per_circ
)
LIMIT 1;
attempts.raw:
SELECT time
FROM lapTimes
WHERE milliseconds = (
  SELECT MIN(min_ms) FROM (
    SELECT MIN(lt.milliseconds) AS min_ms
    FROM lapTimes lt
    JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
    GROUP BY r.circuitId
  ) AS per_circ
)
LIMIT 1;

question: What are the speed in which attacks are put together of the top 4 teams with the highest build Up Play Speed?

attempts.sql:
SELECT t.team_long_name, MAX(ta.buildUpPlaySpeed) AS buildUpPlaySpeed
FROM Team_Attributes ta
JOIN Team t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
GROUP BY ta.team_api_id, t.team_long_name
ORDER BY buildUpPlaySpeed DESC
LIMIT 4;
attempts.raw:
SELECT t.team_long_name, MAX(ta.buildUpPlaySpeed) AS buildUpPlaySpeed
FROM Team_Attributes ta
JOIN Team t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
GROUP BY ta.team_api_id, t.team_long_name
ORDER BY buildUpPlaySpeed DESC
LIMIT 4;

question: List all patients who were followed up at the outpatient clinic who underwent a laboratory test in October 1991 and had a total blood bilirubin level within the normal range.

attempts.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday, p."First Date", p.Admission, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND l.Date LIKE '1991-10%'
  AND l."T-BIL" < 2.0;
attempts.raw:
SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday, p."First Date", p.Admission, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND l.Date LIKE '1991-10%'
  AND l."T-BIL" < 2.0;
